snippet.title: GUNJUTSU - Official Announcement Trailer | FPS Trickshotting Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist GUNJUTSU on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3586440/Gunjutsu/

Follow on X for updates: 
https://x.com/GunjutsuGame

Music: NopeYup - SAD ASIAN
https://on.soundcloud.com/lnAR9M4Tp28vZdW5e8

A Game Built Entirely for the Trickshotting Community.

If you've ever hit a 360 Noscope, this game was made for you.

GUNJUTSU combines the score-chasing creativity of Skate 3 with Call of Duty Trickshotting. Learn the basics, master the Trickshot Iceberg, and compete on the Global Leaderboard.

Split Bullets.
Clone Shots.
Perform Ricochets for Impossible Angles.
Curve Bullets.
